[TOC]

### 前提条件：

- MDVR主机带USB口、遥控器、显示屏、存储介质且存在录像文件
- U盘或USB接口的存储介质必须是FAT32格式

###操作步骤
1、将U盘插入USB口通电开机，遥控左右按键来到磁盘状态界面查看是否识别到U盘
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=d0ece55bf61dd14de3c04d4a899f0e6f)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=107a4e66533cb85efd05ef888a160d52)
ps:没有识别到请多试几次插拔
2、遥控进入菜单设置>>录像设置>>录像界面，移动到USB用途 选择 数据导出，确认保存。
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=ac07c9d748b99f5b091a17f0d7bf52e2)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=ae21772e840bf70bdd6854d07e4e19e7)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=8c1ca37516ef53c80149bb7dce279d4e)
3、按返回键移动到工具>>数据导出>>录像导出界面，选择设备录像存储的磁盘位置、录像类型、时间范围，按确认搜索查询。
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=a10cf78de75e51ac404e7c7eed17f130)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=9519bd0c1ca546029c01b4a8c13c9bd0)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=cf9f4cb52ca61cc2dd2076d91df2f7e3)
4、移动到查询的录像文件列表 按确认键导出想要导出的某个录像文件，弹出导出进度条状态等待100%消失后证明导出成功，拔掉U盘插入电脑即可使用专用回放软件播放。
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=ae35569219b5c233dee53a685078994c)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=d6b0dbe11b58492c64899fb0d06ed666)
